Replaced 'rollback steps are skipped where not needed' and 'steps are retryable' with a numbered list saying what each step does, when catch_up applies (only from new_only), and what happens when each step fails

Added an Open questions section for unknowns: 5,000 minimum scope, rollback record location, duplicate-charge key support, comparison-job failure and consecutive days, on-call paging
